rules.rule: Flag any hardcoded credential, API key, token, password or private key committed in the diff, and recommend moving it to environment configuration or a secret manager.
Flag SQL built by string concatenation or f-string interpolation over variable input; require parameterised queries or bound placeholders.
Flag eval(), exec() or pickle.loads() applied to data that crosses a trust boundary such as request input, user content or files.
Flag subprocess or shell calls that interpolate variables into a single command string instead of passing an argument list, and flag disabled certificate or TLS verification.
Flag new or changed behaviour in the diff that has no corresponding test change; name the specific test case that is missing.
Flag tests that only execute the code without asserting on the result, and tests that restate the implementation's own logic in their assertions.
Flag error paths left untested by the diff: raised exceptions, empty or invalid input, and boundary values.
Flag dead code introduced by the diff: commented-out blocks, unreachable branches, unused imports and unused variables.
Flag misleading names and new public functions or classes shipped without a docstring.
